entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is very important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Isaac, I want to return these absolutely awful shoes I bought. This is completely unacceptable!
I'm very sorry to hear you're not happy with your purchase. I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the cycling shoes?

What's the issue? I'll tell you the issue! I wore them for one single class and they gave me terrible blisters on my heels. They're stiff as a board! And the placement for the cleats feels totally off. They're useless! I want a refund, and I want it now!

I can definitely understand your frustration. Getting blisters is the last thing you want when you're trying to get a good workout in. Let me just pull up your order information... I see you received them just three days ago. You're unfortunately outside our 10-day return policy, so I can absolutely process that return for you.

You're damn right you can! This has been a complete waste of my time. I'm a VIP member and I spend a lot of money here. I expect better than this garbage. I swear I'm about to leave a one-star review everywhere I can think of.

I see your VIP status on your account, sir, and we sincerely appreciate your loyalty. I've already initiated the return process. You'll receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label in the next few minutes. For the trouble and the negative experience, I've also gone ahead and added a $25 credit to your account for your next purchase with us.
A $25 credit? Hmm. Fine. That's... acceptable. I'll be looking for that email. Just make sure that refund hits my account the second you get those shoes back.

Of course. The moment our warehouse scans the return, the refund will be processed to your original payment method. It typically appears within 3 to 5 business days after that. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's it. Just get it done.
It's all in process. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope we can provide you with a better experience next time. Have a good day.
